origin: invented user stories with acceptance bullets for a library app: a statement spans a sentence and its bullets

requirements.start: As a member, I want to search the catalogue by title
As a member, I want to reserve a book that is out
requirements.end: if I do not collect the book.

requirements.start: As a member, I want to see my loans and due dates in one place
As a librarian, I want to scan a book's barcode
As a librarian, I want to export a monthly loans report as CSV
The catalogue search returns in under 1 second
Member data is stored in the EU
The app has to work on the desk computers

not_requirements: As a member, I want recommendations so that I discover new books. Not planned.
